manage_profiles_tiers_hazard: Tiers are positional — adding or removing the last tier is safe; reordering or removing a middle tier will silently rebind agents.
manage_profiles_apply_desc: This will push the current profile registry to all live agents. Each agent rebuilds its failover state on its next wake-up.
manage_profiles_provider_dialog_desc: Configure an LLM provider: family, base URL, and API key.
manage_profiles_provider_id_hint: Locked while editing — renaming would dangle every profile referencing it.
manage_profiles_provider_id_duplicate: This ID is already in use.
manage_profiles_provider_base_url_hint: Required for openai-compatible (e.g. https://host/v1); other families default to their official URL when empty.
manage_profiles_provider_api_key_hint_ed: Current: {mask}. Leave empty to keep, or type to replace.
manage_profiles_tier_dialog_desc: Configure this tier's failover profile list: order is priority, the first is active.
manage_profiles_tier_dialog_no_providers: No providers defined yet — add one in the providers section first.
manage_profiles_tier_drop_here: Drop to move into this tier
manage_profiles_remove_tier_confirm_desc: Tiers are positional: removing a tier rebinds every agent on it and on the tiers after it. Discard reverts this draft.
manage_profiles_tiers_desc_l1: Profiles within a tier fail over when one is unavailable
manage_profiles_tiers_desc_l2: Lower tier index means a more capable model
manage_profiles_tiers_desc_l3: The root agent always runs on tier #0
manage_profiles_tiers_desc_l4: Subagent tiers follow delegation depth (one tier down per nesting level, clamped at the last tier)
manage_profiles_heading_desc_l1: Three layers: providers form a global pool; tier containers hold draggable profile cards
manage_profiles_heading_desc_l3: Profile Test = one minimal real inference
